main: Enjoy a wine bar favorite at home for a fraction of the cost! This quick gambas recipe, featuring tender Korean zucchini (a hobak) and shrimp, comes together in under 10 minutes of active cooking. It's perfect for a speedy weeknight meal or an impressive appetizer.
reply1:
Ingredients for 2 servings:
• 15 frozen shrimp (thawed, patted dry)
• 1/2 a hobak (Korean zucchini), sliced
• 10 cloves garlic, sliced
• 1/2 paper cup olive oil
• 3 peperoncino (dried red chilies)
• 1/2 tsp salt
reply2: Pat shrimp completely dry to prevent oil splatters. Cook garlic in olive oil over low heat for 5 minutes until light brown.
alt_text: Spanish garlic shrimp gambas in a small cast iron pan with sliced zucchini, bubbling olive oil, golden garlic slices and dried red chili, with crusty bread beside it, under warm evening light.
